name: @centrst/blind
description: Rewrite private text into a blind copy with consistent realistic fakes, then map answers back locally
author: Centrst

scripts.test:deep: NUM_RUNS=20000 VITEST_NO_JSON=1 vitest run test/properties test/no-network.test.ts
scripts.lint: eslint src test scripts examples ner/src ner/test ner/scripts
scripts.bench:presidio: tsx scripts/bench/export-corpus.ts && .local/presidio-venv/bin/python scripts/bench/presidio.py && tsx --tsconfig ner/tsconfig.json scripts/bench/score.ts
scripts.bench:gretel:setup: python3.12 -m venv .local/data-venv && .local/data-venv/bin/pip install -r scripts/bench/requirements-gretel.txt && mkdir -p .local/gretel && curl -fL -o .local/gretel/test.parquet https://huggingface.co/datasets/gretelai/synthetic_pii_finance_multilingual/resolve/7b844d16738527a04264f50214cb426a4cea0897/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet
scripts.bench:gretel: .local/data-venv/bin/python -I scripts/bench/gretel_sample.py && .local/presidio-venv/bin/python scripts/bench/presidio.py --input reports/gretel-input.json --out reports/gretel-presidio-raw.json --configs default,with_org && tsx --tsconfig ner/tsconfig.json scripts/bench/score-gretel.ts
scripts.version:release: changeset version && pnpm version:sync && pnpm install --lockfile-only
